question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Charisma
solution:
The correct answer is: **Charm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Charisma"** means a compelling attractiveness or charm that can inspire devotion in others. (आकर्षण)
 
 
• **Example: **The leader's charisma was undeniable, drawing people from all walks of life to support his cause.
 
 
 
• **"Charm" **refers to the power or quality of giving delight or arousing admiration. (मनोहरता)
 
 
• **Example: **Her charm was evident in every interaction, making her well-liked by everyone she met.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Charisma' **is **'Charm'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Charm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reputation **(प्रतिष्ठा): The beliefs or opinions that are generally held about someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a reputation for being very trustworthy.
 
 
 
• **Atmosphere **(वातावरण): The pervading tone or mood of a place, situation, or creative work.
 
 
• **Example: **The restaurant had a romantic atmosphere that made it perfect for dates.
 
 
 
• **Influence** (प्रभाव): The capacity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** His influence over the company was substantial.
